instantaneous_generator_class: measurable H_c(t) in the 60-dimensional corresponding-pair Pauli span
theorem: ST201 proves the commutator map is injective on the declared 60-dimensional span. Hence any measurable time-dependent coefficient vector satisfying pointwise exact energy conservation lies in the zero kernel almost everywhere. Its time-ordered exponential is the identity, so no nontrivial reset is possible in this pointwise-conserving control class.
